name: Grade 7 IIT Practice: July Week 7 - Debugging Roles
description: Practice words for debugging and pair-programming roles.

words.definition: To find and fix a problem in code.
words.example: The pair debugged the script after the score did not change.

words.definition: To follow code step by step.
words.example: The navigator traced the blocks from top to bottom.
The bug made the sprite jump to the wrong place.

words.definition: The partner controlling the computer during pair work.
words.example: The driver controlled the mouse and changed the blocks.

words.definition: The partner who guides and checks the work during pair work.
words.example: The navigator read the checklist and watched for mistakes.

words.definition: Helpful comments about how to improve.
words.example: Feedback helped the pair improve the game controls.
